segments: A silver dome-shaped cover is lifted to unveil a plate with only a whole fish on it. A hand picks up the plate.

The view zooms out, revealing a butler holding the plate and an old man, with his mouth open and still, sitting at the dining table of a dark castle-like space. The butler puts the fish in the man's mouth.
The man does not move and the butler looks at the fish still in his mouth. The butler closes the man's open mouth.
The man starts to move and his eyes open as he moves his head forward.
A grand front door opens by itself, with very bright light beyond it.
The man walks toward the door with no hesitation.
He walks through the door and into the light, disappearing from view.
The butler puts the dome-shaped cover back on the tray. His hand knocks a piece of paper onto the ground, and the camera tilts down.
The piece of paper is revealed to be a menu, with "Ichthy's (specialité de la maison)" written on it. The screen cuts to black.
